title: Casino Royale
author: Ian Fleming
summary: The first James Bond novel sends him to a French casino to bankrupt a Soviet-connected paymaster at the baccarat table. A beautiful colleague is sent to work with him.
readIf: you want to see where James Bond began, in a lean, cold and surprisingly brooding story.
skipIf: you want the glossy gadgets and humour of the films, or modern attitudes, since the book is a product of the fifties.

pairings.reason: The unromantic answer to Bond, showing the same world as grubby, morally murky work.
A more modern spy hero in a faster and more action-driven international chase.
